_note_add_tags: Gross real-estate tags are deliberately a SEPARATE key, not appended to real_estate_assets: the extractor keeps the largest value per year across a metric's tag list, so mixing gross into the net series would silently convert it to gross and break anything measuring depreciated book value.

annotations.equity: GAAP book value understates a REIT: real estate is carried at depreciated historical cost, so long-held properties sit far below market value. Book-value and ROE measures are not meaningful here.
annotations.net_income: Net income is depressed by real-estate depreciation, a non-cash charge on assets that often appreciate. FFO/AFFO are the sector's earnings measures.
annotations.roe: Distorted by depreciated-cost book value; use FFO-based measures instead.

caveats: The coverage audit found RealEstateGrossAtCarryingValue unmapped for 96% of REITs and lease income (the actual revenue line) unmapped for 63% — this sector template closes both.
ROIC is suppressed: 'invested capital' is not a meaningful denominator for a property trust whose assets are carried at depreciated cost.
